Straight answers

Before you trust it with work.

What data does Fusekit handle?

Fusekit stores the records and files people add to each app. Provider credentials stay on the server and never enter the app bundle or browser. Self-hosted Fusekit keeps app data, files, identity, and credentials inside your network.

Can an app change data in our existing systems?

No. Connections to existing company systems are approved by an administrator and expose named, read-only operations. Apps can still create and update their own Fusekit records and files.

How does AI billing work?

On Fusekit Cloud, the in-console builder can use plan credits or a personal provider key. Managed building pauses when the shared balance reaches zero; there is no automatic overage. BYOK bypasses Fusekit credits. AI inside a deployed app always uses your workspace provider key, and self-hosted builder chats are BYOK only.

Is Fusekit SOC 2 certified?

Not today. If your policy requires SOC 2, talk to us before buying. For stricter data-residency requirements, self-hosted Fusekit runs entirely in your network.

What data does Fusekit handle?

Fusekit 存储人们添加到每个应用程序的记录和文件。 提供商凭据保留在服务器上，并且永远不会进入应用程序包或浏览器。 自托管 Fusekit 将应用程序数据、文件、身份和凭据保存在网络内。

Can an app change data in our existing systems?

不需要。与现有公司系统的连接由管理员批准并公开命名的只读操作。 应用程序仍然可以创建和更新自己的 Fusekit 记录和文件。

How does AI billing work?

在 Fusekit Cloud 上，控制台内构建器可以使用计划积分或个人提供商密钥。 当共享余额为零时，托管构建暂停；没有自动超额。 BYOK 绕过 Fusekit 积分。 已部署应用程序内的 AI 始终使用您的工作区提供程序密钥，并且自托管构建器聊天仅限 BYOK。

Is Fusekit SOC 2 certified?

不是今天。 如果您的保单需要 SOC 2，请在购买前与我们联系。 为了满足更严格的数据驻留要求，自托管 Fusekit 完全在您的网络中运行。
